For compatible matrices $A,$ $B,$ and $C,$ and scalar $\alpha ,$ the Hadamard product has the following properties:

- Commutativity:

$$
A⊙B=B⊙A
$$

- Associativity:

$$
(A⊙B)⊙C=A⊙(B⊙C)
$$

- Distributivity over Addition:

$$
A⊙(B+C)=A⊙B+A⊙C
$$

- Scalar Distributivity:

$$
\alpha (A⊙B)=(\alpha A)⊙B=A⊙(\alpha B)
$$

In this case, by the commutativity of the Hadamard product, we have

$$
(Q⊙P+R⊙P)-{X}^{T}=(P⊙Q+P⊙R)-{X}^{T}.
$$

Then, by the distributivity over the addition of the Hadamard product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(P⊙Q+P⊙R)-{X}^{T} & =P⊙(Q+R)-{X}^{T} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 & -2 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 \\ -5 & 2\end{aligned}]}^{T} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 & -2 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}4 & -5 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6-4 & -2-(-5) \\ 1-0 & 3-2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
